description: This class includes the collection of solid or non-solid hazardous waste, e.g. explosive, oxidizing, flammable, toxic, irritant, carcinogenic, corrosive or infectious materials.
includes: collection of hazardous waste: solvents, paints, used oils, medical waste
collection of spent batteries and cells
collection of used oil from ships
operation of transfer stations for hazardous waste
collection of waste oil from households and commercial users
excludes: treatment and disposal of hazardous waste, see 3822
